:::{.theorem data-title="European Put Option Price"}

Under the [[black-scholes-merton-model]] the price of a European vanilla put
option at time with underlying stock , strike $K$ and maturity $T$ is given by
$$
\begin{align}P(S_{t},t)=N(-d_{-})Ke^{-r(T-t)}-N(-d_{+})S_{t}\end{align}
$$
where:
- $d_{+}=\frac{1}{\sigma \sqrt{ T-t }}\left( \log\left(  \frac{S_{t}}{K} \right)+\left( r + \frac{\sigma^2}{2} \right)(T-t) \right)$
- $d_{-}=d_{+}-\sigma \sqrt{ T-t }$.

:::

The price of European put and call options are linked by [[put-call-parity]]
which states that
$$
P(S_{t},t)=Ke^{-r(T-t)}-S_{t}+C(S_{t},t).
$$
